name: oxide-master-glue
description: Transparent 2-bus / master tape finish via the UADx Oxide Tape Recorder. Repro, 15 IPS, NAB, NR on, gentle input_level +4 for near-transparent dynamics (crest ~14.0 from 14.6) + a touch of low-order body. A color insert BEFORE the limiter, not the limiter. The fast/light alternative to the Ampex ATR-102 master-glue preset.
intended_for: a near-final stereo mix / 2-bus wanting subtle tape cohesion before [[master-track]] / render-mastered. Insert before the limiter; do NOT limit here.
plugin_build: uaudio_oxide_tape.vst3 (UADx native — renders headless; the 'UAD Oxide Tape.component' twin passes audio through unprocessed offline, do NOT use it).

target_signature.comment: measured dry -> processed on watercolors_drums_104bpm_8bar_a (peak-normed). dry centroid 3007, crest 14.63. +0 default measured cen 2990 / crest 14.33 (~0.3 dB compression); +4 sits just past that.

notes: Keep it gentle on a master: +4 drive only. Add cohesion until crest drops ~0.5-1 dB, then stop. Drive harder = audible odd-3rd grit on a full mix.
Use Path Select = Input (electronics only, no tape) for a near-clean transformer-flavored 2nd-harmonic sheen with NO tape compression -- a subtler option still.
15 IPS / NAB = the warm, full-low master tone; CCIR = brighter top; 30 IPS does not exist on Oxide (7.5 / 15 only).
It is a color insert, NOT a limiter -- hand loudness/ceiling to render-mastered ([[master-track]]).
Verify: measure-loudness (crest barely moves), measure-spectrum, check-clipping, render-ab loudness-matched.
